task.description: WF-03 Step 1 for GH-379 / ISS-0116. Run DLQ integration tests to establish baseline: test-integration-sch303, test-integration-svc (for TC-OBS-05/06 via main_test.zig). Classify failures and identify root cause.
acceptance_criteria: All failing TC-OBS-05 and TC-OBS-06 tests identified
Root cause classified per Category A-E
Specific source lines to fix identified

result.summary:
Diagnosis complete. Category: D — Test error; source (production DLQ code) is correct; test assertion SQL is wrong.

Findings:
1. TC-SCH-303: 4/4 PASS (already fixed by prior work — no action needed).
2. TC-OBS-06-INT-01..05: All PASS (no action needed).
3. TC-OBS-05-INT-01: PASS.
4. TC-OBS-05-INT-02: FAIL — `rowCount` query at obs05_dlq_test.zig:395 uses `resource_id = $1::uuid`. `audit_entries.resource_id` was migrated from UUID to TEXT by migration GBL-120 (ISS-103). Comparing TEXT = UUID gives PostgreSQL error C42804.
5. TC-OBS-05-INT-03: FAIL — same root cause, `rowCount` query at obs05_dlq_test.zig:462.

Root cause: Identical pattern to ISS-0638 (GH-621, fixed 2026-08-09 in adp02_tenant_scope_test.zig). The test SQL casts $1 to UUID when the column is TEXT.

Fix: In tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig, change:
  Line 395: `resource_id = $1::uuid` → `resource_id = $1`
  Line 462: `resource_id = $1::uuid` → `resource_id = $1`

Note: `actor_id = $2::uuid` at line 395 is correct — `actor_id` column remains UUID.
result.next_action: Route to ISSUE-FIXER Step 2 (apply fix to tests/integration/obs05_dlq_test.zig)
